g.text: Two equal rejection tails, but UNEQUAL slice lengths
Blue segment rotated for comparison, not rescaled.
The orange segment is about 29% longer.
Why? Under a larger candidate b, the sampling spread is larger: SD(X) = b / sqrt(12).
Unequal lengths do NOT break inversion: the same point is inside both slices, or outside both.
